correctness.rationale: The operator is weighted cyclic shift on each permutation cycle. Every nonzero assignment gives a cyclic module with annihilator t^d-c and count (q-1)^(d-1); zero positions split into Jordan chains and circular-gap positions count d(z-1)!/prod m_r!. Independent cycles convolve, with no characteristic assumptions. The F7 idempotent equations give 4 versus 1. Finite direct ranks-of-powers tests on 34 prime-field instances and the F7 comparison reproduce these conclusions but are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: This provides a complete exact intrinsic distribution of every rational canonical module type of L_x over arbitrary finite fields, including inseparable cycles, for every permutation cycle type and not just isolated ranks or invertible cases. It exhibits, by a nonisomorphic F7 pair with different idempotent counts, the sharp information loss of this natural all-operator invariant. The task is algebraically motivated by evolution algebras and linear dynamics, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
